statements.t: The Company's CTL financing is a long-term, fixed-rate financing supported primarily by Ford lease payments and related project collateral.

risks.t: changes in automotive and other customer production volumes
customer demand, pricing and competitive pressures
the loss or reduction of customer business
our ability to implement operating, cost-reduction and efficiency initiatives and improve intermodal performance
fuel, equipment, insurance and claims costs
the performance of customers and other counterparties, including those supporting the CTL financing
interest rates and the availability and cost of capital
our ability to comply with financial covenants and access unused or incremental revolving commitments
